policy_extraction.issuing_body: Presidential Committee on the Digital Platform Government / National Information Society Agency
covered_actors: Central ministries, local governments, public institutions, National Assembly, and courts (전 공공부문), public-sector IT system managers, and contracting agencies (발주기관)
Private cloud computing service providers (CSAP-certified IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS providers)

Private hyperscale AI, LLM, sLLM, RAG, and AI service vendors and project contractors (수행기관) supplying AI systems via the Pan-Government Hyperscale AI Common Foundation, Digital Service Support System, or public procurement tenders

evidence.quote:
- 단말은 기관 전산망 내 존재하는 인증·통제 서버를 통해 AI 서비스 활용을 사전에 승인 받은 후 보안 조치를 마쳐야 함
- AI 서비스 계정 정보는 업무 시스템 정보와 분리해 관리하고 계정별 접근 권한과 사용 이력도 별도로 추적·기록
evidence.quote_en: Work terminals must obtain prior approval for AI service use through authentication/control servers inside the agency network and complete security measures; AI account credentials must be segregated from work systems, with per-account access rights and usage logs tracked separately.

evidence.quote: - 업무 단말에서 생성형 AI에 정보 입력 시 발생할 수 있는 정보 유출을 차단하기 위해 콘텐츠 필터링과 AI가 생성한 텍스트 또는 문서에 잘못된 결과물(악성 URL 등)로 인해 유해사이트로 접근하는 것을 차단하기 위한 보안 통제 항목 필요
evidence.quote_en: Content filtering to block information leakage when entering data into generative AI from work terminals and security controls blocking access to harmful sites via malicious URLs in AI outputs are required.

evidence.quote:

evidence.quote_en: Principle 4: Guarantee national security and citizens' rights—prevent external leakage of sensitive and classified data, and protect personal information and copyright in training data.

evidence.quote: ●RAG 기반 모델은 모델 자체를 재학습하지 않으므로, 최신 정보 반영이 가능하나 활용 데이터의 신뢰성을 보장해야 하므로 백터DB 등 관리가 중요
evidence.quote_en: Because RAG-based models reflect up-to-date information without retraining the base model, governing vector databases and guaranteeing the trustworthiness of retrieved data are critical.

enforcement_authorities: Presidential Committee on the Digital Platform Government (디지털플랫폼정부위원회)
National AI Committee (국가인공지능위원회 — referenced for 2030 public AI policy targets)
National Intelligence Service (국가정보원 — N2SF security guidelines and agency security reviews)
Ministry of the Interior and Safety (행정안전부)
Korea Internet & Security Agency (한국인터넷진흥원, KISA — CSAP cloud security certification)
compliance_deadlines: 2030: Policy target cited from the National AI Committee's National AI Strategy Policy Direction (Sept 2024) to achieve a 95% public-sector AI adoption rate
policy_extraction.implementation_notes: Major Version 2.0 revision (April 2025) superseding the April 2024 guideline, issued by the Presidential Committee on the Digital Platform Government and NIA. Substantially expands operational governance over Version 1.0 by: (1) adding the Pan-Government Hyperscale AI Common Foundation priority policy and Public AI 3 Strategic Goals (targeting 95% public AI adoption by 2030); (2) completing Section 3.2.1 with the NIS National Network Security Framework (N2SF) Classified/Sensitive/Open (C/S/O) tiering, terminal authorization, account segregation, MFA, outbound content/URL filtering, and NIS security review; (3) adding RAG as a 4th architectural pathway with vector-DB governance; (4) incorporating the May 2024 OECD AI Principles alongside MSIT's 2020 AI Ethics Principles; (5) introducing Part 4's lifecycle AI Performance Management Framework and 344-metric KPI pool (covering ethics compliance, security vulnerability remediation, test coverage, explainability, human intervention, and appeal rates); and (6) cataloging 110 domestic public AI pilots and 1,802 international public AI cases while noting DeepSeek/open-source, multimodal, and agentic AI trends (without imposing dedicated open-weight or agentic autonomy mandates).

risk_framing.rationale_summary: Version 2.0 of the Public-Sector Hyperscale AI Guideline remains dominantly framed around innovation_enablement: it operationalizes Korea's push toward 95% public-sector AI adoption by 2030 via three strategic goals (citizen service innovation, social problem-solving, administrative efficiency), a shared Pan-Government Hyperscale AI Common Foundation to eliminate silos and duplicate investments, RAG/multi-cloud adoption pathways, fast-track Digital Service procurement, and a 344-indicator lifecycle performance framework. Innovation_enablement decisively leads secondary frames, yet Version 2.0 markedly elevates national_security compared to Version 1.0 by integrating NIS's National Network Security Framework (N2SF) C/S/O classification for defense/diplomatic/intelligence secrets, cyber-exfiltration threat controls, and NIS security reviews. Economic_competitiveness (global AI supremacy competition post-DeepSeek, international benchmarking, domestic AI ecosystem/GovTech growth), fundamental_rights (citizens' rights, privacy, copyright, 2024 OECD AI Principles on human rights/explainability/recourse, accessibility), and consumer_public_safety (24-hour citizen safety, disaster/crowd/emergency protection, mitigating hallucinations and malicious outputs) form balanced supporting rationales.

evidence_spans.quote: ①(대국민 서비스 혁신) AI로 실현하는 초개인화·無장애 대국민 서비스 제공 확대 ②(사회문제 해결) AI를 활용한 데이터 분석과 실시간 대응역량 강화로 복잡하고 다양한 사회문제 해결 ③(일하는 방식 효율화) AI와 협업을 통해 일상적 업무를 효율화하고 정책지능 향상으로 최적의 의사결정 지원
evidence_spans.quote_en: Three Public AI Strategic Goals: (1) Citizen Service Innovation via hyper-personalized barrier-free services; (2) Social Problem-Solving via AI data analysis and real-time response; (3) Work Efficiency via AI collaboration and enhanced policy intelligence.

evidence_spans.quote: - AI 자산의 공유·재활용을 통한 중복개발 및 AI 사일로(silo) 현상 등을 방지하고, 신속한 서비스 개발 환경 기반 마련
evidence_spans.quote_en: Prevents duplicate development and AI silos through sharing and reuse of AI assets and establishes a foundation for rapid service development.

evidence_spans.quote: - 기밀정보(C)는 비밀, 안보·국방·외교·수사 등의 기밀정보와 국민 생활·생명·안전과 직결된 정보로써 정보공개법 제9조(비공개 대상 정보)의 제1호부터 제4호까지를 포함
evidence_spans.quote_en: Classified information (Tier C) comprises state secrets and classified security, defense, diplomacy, and investigation data as well as information directly linked to citizens' lives and safety.

evidence_spans.quote: - 중국의 AI 기업 DeepSeek가 중국 최초의 오픈소스 초거대 AI 모델을 공개하면서 서구 중심의 AI 주도권에 도전하며 AI 패권 경쟁 가속화.
evidence_spans.source_section: 1.2 초거대 AI 발전 경과 및 최근 기술 동향
evidence_spans.quote_en: China's AI firm DeepSeek released China's first open-source hyperscale AI model, challenging Western AI leadership and accelerating global AI hegemony competition.

evidence_spans.quote: - AI 시스템이 법치주의·인권·민주적가치·다양성을 존중할 수 있도록 설계되어야 하며 공정하고 정의로운 사회를 보장하기 위한 적절한 안전장치 고려 필요
evidence_spans.source_section: 3.1 도입 원칙 및 고려사항 - [참고] OECD AI 원칙
evidence_spans.quote_en: AI systems should be designed to respect the rule of law, human rights, democratic values, and diversity, with appropriate safeguards to ensure a fair and just society.

evidence_spans.quote: ∙(모니터링·알람) 공공부문 실시간 데이터를 분석하여 사회 안전·재난·위험 등의 이상 징후를 감지하고 선제적으로 이를 알람으로 제공하는 서비스
evidence_spans.quote_en: Monitoring & Alarm: Services analyzing real-time public-sector data to detect anomalies in public safety, disasters, and hazards and issue proactive alerts.
